plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: Spec-driven Claude Code plugin. Audit a repo for the work worth doing, grill business + technical goals as distinct passes, plan into a dependency-ordered task graph, build hands-off. Product memory (North Star + Status/roadmap + Language + target surface + Architecture + History) lives in .claude/product.md; operational memory and token discipline come from OpenWolf (required); the laziest-working-diff build discipline is owned in-plugin.
